about_the_game:
In ShootX, you take on the role of a soldier and fight against enemy AI opponents. The game offers fast-paced first-person shooter action in which you defeat your opponents with various weapons or fight your way through the levels. You can play the game in your own way, either by jumping straight into battle or taking a strategic approach.

Currently, the free basic version of ShootX offers a single-player experience on one map. You fight against computer-controlled opponents and use various weapons to defeat them. Your progress is supported by Auto Heal regeneration, so you can quickly get back on your feet even after tough battles.

Key features:

Classic first-person shooter gameplay with various weapons

Single-player battles against AI opponents

Auto Heal regeneration for quick recovery in combat

One level for exploring and fighting enemies

Multiple difficulty levels for different gaming experiences

Regular content updates with new missions and maps (DLCs)

Unreal Engine 5 for impressive graphics

In the future, ShootX will be regularly expanded with DLCs that will bring new maps, missions and content. These expansions will be subject to a charge, but the basic version will remain free of charge.

content_descriptors.notes: The game has violence in the form of weapons and killing. The weapons and vehicles are realistic. The enemies lie on the ground after they are dead. There is NO nudity.
